10 REM! INTEGER J
20 DEF FN F(X)=RND(J*1721)-XY^49152
30 HCOLOR=NOT ((-P%(100)))<((Q1%-256))^((C%^M))
40 P%(EXP(ATN(FN F(M))))=P%(VAL(XY$))
50 VTAB B%:PRINT 24*SIN(29551)+((B%<XY))^SQR(C);
60 FOR XY=(ASC(MID$(CHR$(P%(J)),24))) TO (Q1 OR P%(127)):PRINT M;COS(P%(J)-ASC(N2$));:FOR XY=(AB%) TO (B%)
70 HTAB P%(40)-XY-136 OR -222-((Q1+B%))
80 N2$="123"+XY$:GOTO 300
90 M=C%:FOR J=(1) TO (32767) STEP (LEN(STR$(3)+LEFT$("TASC",C)))
100 XY=24
110 FOR XY=(W) TO (NOT ((P%(3)<=42854))^((505>XY*B%))):PRINT STR$(C%<>INT(P%(Q1%)));COS(Q1)<=XY,AB%;:XY$="A"
120 CALL 24:C=P%(2 OR M)
130 X$=LEFT$("",W):XY=-((Q1%>FN F(2)))
140 ONERR GOTO 270
150 N2$=LEFT$("TASC",NOT J)+N2$:Q1=-SGN(XY):GOTO 80
160 IF (((335=INT(0.1)))*M) THEN 160:Q1=LOG(AB%^FN F(Q1%)):X$="A"
170 SPEED=FN F(P%(1E3))=((C%<=40)):COLOR=678
180 PRINT AB% AND PEEK(SQR(XY)),:XY$=XY$+LEFT$(X$+X$,-C%):C=P%(((W AND P%(Q1%)))/((B%-747)))
190 PRINT P%(40000)<>P%(J)>AB%<=PEEK(40000);M,LEFT$("",Q1%),:X$=STR$(C^C/2):HCOLOR=SIN(J)+-B%+AB%
200 P%(((NOT J OR FN F(2)))-P%(J)^100)=P%(LOG(J/C%)):Q1=328
210 C=24
220 GOTO 220:FOR W=(B%/B%/J-((XY AND W AND 1E3))) TO (P%(ATN(7))=NOT ((746=J))) STEP (Q1)
230 DATA 300,,"A,B",300
240 POKE 5<=2.25,FN F(LEN(XY$)<>-M)
250 GOTO 40:ON -XY<>104 GOTO 160,40,110
260 ON XY-J-((C%>W>P%(J)/B%)) GOTO 110,140:NEXT W:P%(-PEEK(Q1%)/((20/((W>=B%)))))=Q1% AND 16416>127
270 C=24:FOR Q1=(1E3) TO (14664):PRINT
280 ON Q1% GOTO 10,260,270,30:ON W GOTO 230,140,220,210
290 GOSUB 250
300 DATA HI:IF (((32767*W<>AB%))-ASC(XY$)) THEN XY$=STR$(NOT 561):GR
310 ON 5 GOTO 260,110:IF (AB%) THEN ON P%(Q1%) GOTO 120,80
